content.caption: Green checkmark icon indicating that wiki access is enabled for a WikiSkill component in the ablation table.
content.description: A small green checkmark symbol, cropped from Table 3 of the WikiSkill ablation study. In the table, this mark denotes that a component (the Inference Agent or the Skill Proposer) has wiki access in a given configuration. A red cross marks the opposite case.
